title: fix(spec): in-system copy says "this system" or drops the noun, not "this environment" (cloud#3002 ruling A)
body:
Fixes #24406

Clause-②: no

## What this does

Published copy in `packages/spec` called the running system "this environment". objectstack-ai/cloud#3002 ruling A, as the card quotes it, reads each string by its sense:

- a set "made here, not from a package" reads "authored in this system";
- "the system the caller is in" drops the noun, or says "this system";
- a string that means a deployment or configuration scope keeps its word.

This PR reads every non-test `this environment` hit in `packages/spec/src`: `git grep -c` answers 15 on `origin/main` `538f923cb9`, the card's sites plus the addendum's TSDoc. 11 change and 4 keep the word, each with its reason in the table. The spelling matches what the `services` PR (#24407) and the `cloud-connection` / `mcp` PR (#24413) landed.

Wording only. No refusal `code`, status, kind, issue path, accept set or export moves.

## Per-string reading

All sites are under `packages/spec/src/`. Line numbers are on `538f923cb9`; no line moves.

| site | before | after, or kept: reason |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `security/permission-set-owner-binding.ts:127`, the `packageId` refusal on the save, restore and publish doors | "a set written into no package is authored in this environment, which an absent `packageId` states" | "… is authored in this system, …" (made here) |
| `security/permission.form.ts:52`, Setup help text for `packageId` | "Leave empty for a set created in this environment." | "Leave empty for a set authored in this system." (made here) |
| `security/permission.zod.ts:680`, the `permission.managedBy` tombstone prescription | "and a set created in this environment carries neither." | "and a set authored in this system carries neither." (made here) |
| `migrations/entries/semantic/18.permission-set-managed-by-retired.ts:18`, upgrade-guide `replacement` | "a set created in this environment carries neither." | "a set authored in this system carries neither." (made here; the same sentence as the tombstone) |
| `system/auth-config.zod.ts:345`, TSDoc of `AudienceConfigSchema` | "who may become a user of an app built on this environment" | "… an app built on this system" (the system the reader is in) |
| `system/auth-config.zod.ts:401`, TSDoc of `posture` | "Who may become a user of this environment's apps:" | "Who may become a user of this system's apps:" (the sentence #24407 gave Setup's Authentication group) |
| `system/auth-config.zod.ts:417`, describe of `posture` | "Who may self-register into this environment: invite_only …" | "Who may self-register: invite_only …" (noun dropped, as plugin-auth's self-registration refusals now read) |
| `system/auth-config.zod.ts:581`, TSDoc of `audience` | "who may become a user of this environment's apps" | "who may become a user of this system's apps" |
| `system/auth-config.zod.ts:601`, describe of `audience` | "Audience posture: who may self-register into this environment (…)" | "Audience posture: who may self-register (…)" (noun dropped) |
| `api/protocol.zod.ts:3373`, describe of `AiModelsResponse.models` | "Models this environment offers" | "Models this system offers" (the system the caller asks; it also holds for the adapter `listModels()` fallback shape, which has no plan behind it) |
| `contracts/metadata-service.ts:393`, TSDoc of `IMetadataService.listDiagnosed` | a consumer that renders "this environment contains N items" | "this system contains N items" (a rendering inside the running system) |
| `data/seed-loader.zod.ts:265`, TSDoc of `env` | "Only datasets matching this environment are loaded." | kept: names the deployment tier. `env` is the `prod`, `dev` or `test` enum, resolved from `config.env` or `NODE_ENV` (`metadata-protocol` `SeedLoader.resolveEnvConfig`) |
| `data/seed-loader.zod.ts:269`, describe of `env` | "Only load datasets matching this environment" | kept: the same key and the same deployment tier |
| `migrations/entries/semantic/18.package-uninstall-environment-wide.ts:21`, upgrade-guide `replacement` | "the uninstall removes every row bound to the package in this environment" | kept: names the ADR-0131 D6 environment-wide scope, against the organization scope the retired `organizationId` / `allTenants` keys named. The entry id and its `acceptanceCriteria` say "environment-wide", and so does the runtime's own remedy for a write sent with an organization |
| `system/environment-artifact.zod.ts:155`, TSDoc of the consent-record key | "no consent record exists for this environment" | kept: the environment artifact is the per-deployment envelope the control plane assembles, and the consent record it carries is per deployment |

## Generated outputs, by their generators only

- `content/docs/references/{api/protocol,security/permission,system/auth-config}.mdx` come from `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec gen:docs`, after `check:generated` named `check:docs` as the one stale artifact (1 of 14).
- `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/en.metadata-forms.generated.ts` comes from `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write`, after `pnpm check:i18n` reported `platform-objects DRIFTED (1)`. One line moves, the `packageId` help text. The `zh-CN`, `ja-JP` and `es-ES` bundles are untouched, and no key is added or dropped. No `packages/platform-objects` source file is edited.

## Tests and pins

No test in the repository pins any of the old sentences: `git grep -F` over the tree finds each only in its source, the generated pages and released changelogs. The tombstone test `permission-set-managed-by-retirement.test.ts` pins the prescription with a regex whose `.*` spans the changed clause, so no pin needed re-truing.

## Changeset

`.changeset/24406-spec-this-system-copy.md` is a `patch` for `@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/platform-objects`. Both publish: neither sets `private`, and `src/**/*.zod.ts`, `dist` and the generated bundle ship.

## Verification

Every reading below is at HEAD `9fcf38b94b`, the final commit, on base `538f923cb9`. Each exit code was captured before any pipe.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`, through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`: `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: "✓ All 14 generated artifacts are up to date". Before `gen:docs` it read "✗ 1 of 14 artifact(s) stale: content/docs/references/**".
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: `Test Files 697 passed (697)`, `Tests 21267 passed | 1 todo (21268)`, exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects test`: `Test Files 77 passed (77)`, `Tests 1184 passed (1184)`, exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects typecheck`: exit 0, with "check:test-typecheck: OK". This was taken after `formula`, `lint` and `core` were rebuilt with declarations.
- `pnpm check:i18n`: before the regeneration, exit 1 with "platform-objects DRIFTED (1)". After it, exit 0 with "OK (10 package(s) — all bundles in sync, no undeclared authoring keys)".
- The derived gate families come from `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 109 for this diff. The `--ran` reconciliation answers "109 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 107 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED (2 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)". 106 exited 0.
  - NOT MEASURED: `check:skill-examples` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET). They read the declarations or built output of packages outside this diff's build closure, such as `client-react` and `studio`. CI's required jobs run them on a full build.
  - `check:dts-closure` exited 1, naming 53 packages with no `.d.ts`. Every one of them is a package this worktree built JS-only (`OS_SKIP_DTS=1`) so the i18n generator's CLI could run, so the reading describes the local tree, not this diff. CI measures it on its own full build.
- No ablation and no reverse verification: the diff changes copy only, and no test pins the old sentences.

## Acceptance notes

These were read and are not this card's to move, being outside the census or outside this lane. Carrier for each: none.

- `packages/client/src/index.ts:6702`, the TSDoc of `ai.models()`, and `content/docs/api/plugin-endpoints.mdx:112`, a hand-written page listed in `scripts/docs-audit/handwritten-docs.json`, still say "Models this environment offers". They mirror the describe this PR moves.
- `packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager.ts:1024` carries the same "this environment contains N items" rationale as the `IMetadataService` TSDoc, in a comment.
- `security/permission-set-owner-binding.ts:103`, on the build and register doors, says "environment-authored". It is outside the literal census, and "environment-authored" is the documented name for that class of metadata (`content/docs/permissions/*.mdx`, `content/docs/deployment/install-modes.mdx`). So it keeps its word, as "the environment catalog" did in the sibling PRs.
- `api/protocol.zod.ts:3359` ("the environment's plan-filtered picker list") and `:3371` ("Whether this is the environment default") are outside the literal census. They name the deployment's plan-scoped allowlist and its configured default. `:3359` cites `ADR-0028`, which in this registry is the metadata-naming ADR, not a model allowlist. The record it means is probably a cloud one, which AGENTS.md cites as `cloud ADR-NNNN`.
- The released `CHANGELOG.md` entries and consumed `.changeset/pre/*` files keep the old sentences. They are release-owned.
